name: mcp-instagram
description: Read Instagram profiles, posts, stories and comments, and like, comment and follow.
long_description: Unofficial Instagram integration through its private mobile API, using a client ported from instagrapi. Instagram may flag or restrict accounts used through unofficial APIs, so prefer a secondary account. Write actions (likes, comments, follows) are rate limited by the server. You log in with your username and password (two-factor codes are requested when needed) or with the session cookie of a logged-in browser; the session is saved privately in ~/.config/mcp-instagram (or %APPDATA%\mcp-instagram on Windows).

ig_username.title: Instagram username
ig_username.description: Your Instagram username, for password login.

ig_password.title: Instagram password
ig_password.description: Used once, encrypted, to log in; never written to disk. If Instagram asks for a two-factor code, you will be asked for it in the conversation.

ig_session_id.title: Instagram session ID (alternative to a password)
ig_session_id.description: Optional: the `sessionid` cookie from instagram.com in a browser where you are logged in. Treat it like a password.
